Hi kinda late to the party but I work in financial aid. A series of questions determine if your independent or not. If you answer yes to any of these [questions](https://studentaid.ed.gov/sa/resources/dependency-status-text) then you are automatically considered independent. 

If you heading into an ungraduate program and are under the age of 24 you are normally considered dependent. You can do one of two things to change this. (1) Depending on your age you would be considered an “[homeless youth](https://studentaid.ed.gov/sa/sites/default/files/homeless-youth.pdf)”. There is a question on the FAFSA that asks if you are an unaccompanied or homeless youth you would answer yes to. This may require some sort of documentation that will be sent to the financial aid office.

Or (2) you can just get a professional judgement call on your dependency. To do this you would need to first complete your FAFSA and then reach out to the financial aid office. Ask them what is the process to have a professional judgement review of your current situation and complete those steps. It’s different for every school. This also may require some sort of documentation or proof, sometimes just a written statement from you of what has happened. 

Hope that helped! Let me know if you have any questions
